title: DNA Normalization with Custom Labware
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare CSV file
steps.instruction: Create a .csv file that lists the diluent volume for every well of the 96‑well plate; include a value for each well (zero is allowed) and format the file in portrait orientation where the bottom‑left corner is A1 and the top‑right corner is H12.

steps.title: Configure protocol in OT‑2 App
steps.instruction: In the protocol customization fields of the OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later), upload the CSV file, select the P10 Multi mount (left or right), set any additional parameters, then download the generated protocol file.

steps.title: Load labware onto deck
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the OT‑2 deck according to the deck map:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: NEST 12‑well reservoir (15 mL); add diluent to well A1.

steps.title: Attach pipette and load tips
steps.instruction: Mount the Opentrons P10 single‑channel pipette on the chosen mount (left or right) and ensure the 10 µL tip rack is loaded.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑App, run the calibration routine for the tip rack, reservoir, and 96‑well plate; follow the support article for calibration tips if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑App
steps.instruction: In the OT‑App, upload the previously downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑App; the robot will transfer the specified diluent volumes from the reservoir to each well of the 96‑well plate as defined in the CSV.
